messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a Grafana page to correlate provisioning queue latency + power-normalized GPU utilization + node thermals. Want quick feedback before I add panels & alerts.

tim: SGTM. Can we surface per-tenant queue depth + 95p allocation latency? Those are the main pain points for product teams.

sasha: +1. Also add a normalized power metric (watts per active slot) so we can compare racks with different densities.

maria: Draft PromQLs I'm testing: 
```promql
sum by(tenant) (gpu_provision_queue_length)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(gpu_alloc_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, tenant))
```

kevin: For power normalization I'm using this: 
```promql
sum by(rack) (rate(gpu_power_watts_total[5m])) / max(1, sum by(rack) (gpu_allocated_slots))
```
This gives watts/slot so racks are comparable.

sasha: We should turn the heavy queries into recording rules (so dashboards/alerts are cheap). e.g. `record: tenant:gpu:queue_rate:5m` and `tenant:gpu:alloc_p95:5m`.

maria: Agreed. Plan: add recording rules + one rollup node-level panel for thermals. Proposal for thermal paging: warn at 85°C sustained for 5m, critical at 92°C for 1m.

tim: Can we debounce noisy sensors? Suggest escalation only if 2/3 of nodes in a rack breach the threshold, otherwise just annotate the dashboard.

maria: Good call — grouping by rack for alerts. Also adding a small SLO card: allocation success rate within latency target. Example SLO: 99.9% allocations < 20s over a 30d window.

infra-bot: deploybot: Recording rule `tenant:gpu:queue_rate:5m` applied to prometheus-prod (cluster-a) at 2026-03-15T18:23:00Z :white_check_mark:

kevin: One more ask: add a panel for 'power-normalized 95p over time' and overlay region tags (us-west-1 / eu-central) — region constraints skew power/thermal profiles and provisioning latency.

maria: Will do. Dropping a draft dashboard UID: abcDEF123. Plan: PR with panels, recording rules, alert rules, and a short on-call runbook.

tim: :thumbsup: Also include a tiny table for high-cost racks (watts / successful allocations) so finance can scan for hotspots.

maria: Will add that and include notes about using the recording rules in Cost Analyzer. Thanks team :party_parrot:
